t: This is Vadnie Bish House, a building in Kentish Town. It takes its name from Vadnie Bish, a social worker who was active in 1987. That date tells you roughly when her work was recognised, and the name suggests the building has a community or social purpose, though I can't confirm what it's used for today. I don't have more about her career or how the building came to be named for her, so I'll stop there rather than fill the gap with guesswork.
